title: Surreal Night Bridge
description: A surreal night scene features a stone bridge over reflective water where a blue armored knight holds a banner reading 'NO MORE HEROES'. In the background, a red devil with horns stands beside a large yellow moon, a hooded green figure holds a glowing lantern, a giant mummy labeled 'NO MIND' stands near a golden eastern dragon, all under a swirling blue and purple cosmic sky with musical notes floating above.
prompt: Surreal fantasy night landscape with swirling cosmic blue and purple sky, large glowing yellow moon, red horned devil silhouette on the left, hooded green figure with glowing lantern in the center, golden eastern dragon curling in the sky, tall green mummy labeled NO MIND on the right, blue armored knight standing on a stone bridge holding a banner that says NO MORE HEROES, water reflection below showing inverted figures, dark trees framing the scene, colorful paint splashes and floating musical notes, dramatic and symbolic composition
